spots.text: WET BOOKS WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED

secrets.name: The Dry Room
secrets.text: Behind the water it is perfectly dry: dust on the shelves, a warm lamp, a towel folded on the chair. Somebody has been waiting out the weather for a long time.

meta.label: The Rain Room
meta.blurb: It is raining in the reading room. It has always been raining in the reading room. The books have been put under glass, and nobody has thought to do anything else.
